changes: Added shared DONE oracle rows and refactored status/next/reviewer rendering to consume gate rows; added phase-aware validate and bug_update hints; hardened channel author checks; documented and verified stale global fallback boundaries.
usage: Use node packages/main/dist/cli.js status or next to see gate-derived next steps; use node packages/main/dist/cli.js validate --story=B-e61b --json for current worktree validation; use node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex to check Codex adapter evidence.
expectedOutcome: In TEST, user sees DONE pre-check rows with exact failing ids and remediation, validate points REVIEW to TEST not DONE, and stale global koala is marked heartbeat-only rather than current-worktree evidence.
actualTranscript: node packages/main/dist/cli.js status showed DONE pre-check from gate rows: test evidence pass, coverage 9/9, freshness pass, git clean pass, branch synced pass, relatedDocs pass, with only delivery-check and story-summary missing before summary. node packages/main/dist/cli.js validate --channel --story=B-e61b --json passed. node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex passed with a warning that global @koala-agent/core resolves to main, not current worktree, so global koala is heartbeat-only.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible behavior gap after current worktree validation; remaining DONE pre-check items are required delivery and summary artifacts, not product behavior failures.
limitations: global koala installed outside this worktree cannot be made current until branch changes are merged or relinked; verify_codex now surfaces this as heartbeat-only stale fallback evidence.
pitfalls: Avoid parallel writes to Koala finding JSON; one parallel resolve was overwritten. After merging main, refresh story validation with --story so test-evidence freshness updates. Merge conflict commits touching source must have koala-implementer author or channel gate fails.
